title: 3424. Minimum Cost to Make Arrays Identical

examples.explanation: Split arr into two contiguous subarrays: [-7] and [9, 5] and rearrange them as [9, 5, -7], with a cost of 2. Subtract 2 from element arr[0]. The array becomes [7, 5, -7]. The cost of this operation is 2. Subtract 7 from element arr[1]. The array becomes [7, -2, -7]. The cost of this operation is 7. Add 2 to element arr[2]. The array becomes [7, -2, -5]. The cost of this operation is 2. The total cost to make the arrays equal is 2 + 2 + 7 + 2 = 13.
Since the arrays are already equal, no operations are needed, and the total cost is 0.
